tools.name: ticketsauce_list_events
tools.description: List the events you own on Ticketsauce with id, name, slug, start/end (local and UTC), venue address, timezone, organization, privacy type, whether tickets are on sale, and the event and ticket-shop URLs. Filter by start/end/created dates (yyyy-mm-dd, UTC), a phrase such as this_weekend, organizatio

tools.name: ticketsauce_get_event
tools.description: One event by id or slug: everything in the list plus summary and description (text and HTML), order_count and ticket_count (tickets sold, not refunded or voided). Replies are cached for an hour. GET /v2/event/{id_or_slug}.

tools.name: ticketsauce_list_orders
tools.description: Orders of one event, oldest first by default (pass sort_dir desc for newest first): order id, status, buyer name, email, phone and address, totals (total_paid, refund_amount, taxes, fees), promo code, ticket_count, paid date. Contains your customers' personal data. Filter by order or modified dates,

tools.name: ticketsauce_get_order
tools.description: One order by id, with its buyer details, totals and its tickets (ticket type, name, price, redeemed state, promo code). Contains personal data. Replies are cached for an hour. GET /v2/order/{order_id}.

tools.name: ticketsauce_list_checkin_ids
tools.description: The ticket check-in ids of one event, for door/scanning reconciliation (the API documents no response fields; the reply is returned as is). Paged: per_page up to 5000, then pass next_page. Replies are cached for 5 minutes. GET /v2/tickets/checkin_ids/{event_id}.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: ticketsauce_list_events, ticketsauce_get_event, ticketsauce_list_orders, ticketsauce_get_order, ticketsauce_list_checkin_ids · Private data: ticketsauce_list_checkin_ids · Public sink: ticketsauce_list_orders.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: ticketsauce_list_events, ticketsauce_get_event, ticketsauce_list_orders, ticketsauce_get_order, ticketsauce_list_checkin_ids · Private data: ticketsauce_list_checkin_ids · Public sink: ticketsauce_list_orders

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
